content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Roanoke

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you meet PMI's education and professional project-management experience requirements for the PMP credential. Review the specific combination of degree level and hours of documented project work PMI requires. Contact Granite PM Academy if you need clarification on how your background qualifies.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Certification Training course. Attend sessions on your schedule from anywhere, learning from active certified practitioners. This formal education is a PMI prerequisite and prepares you directly for exam content.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Create your PMI account and submit your official PMP application, documenting your project-management experience and training completion. Pay the PMI examination fee upon approval. Allow time for PMI to review and authorize your eligibility before scheduling your exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice questions and strategy guides, to reinforce your learning. Schedule your PMP exam through PMI's authorized testing partner. Sit for the computer-based exam and receive your results upon completion.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) across the standard three-year renewal cycle to keep your certification active. Pursue PDUs through training, volunteering, speaking, or authoring—aligned with PMI's practice domains. Renew with PMI before your credential expires to remain current.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.
